findings.title: Level 59 defenses have moved forward
findings.detail: Life is 3350 (+886), ES 234 (+45), Armour 1174 (+290), Evasion 1351 (+697), and physical maximum hit 3805 (+986) versus level 51. Spell Suppression rose 5%→27%; Chaos Resistance improved from -4% to 25%. PoB reports 9339.6 Total EHP and 12800 maximum hit for each elemental damage type.
findings.action: Keep building Life and physical mitigation before spending more points on damage. The newly allocated Melding and Instinct routes are strong defensive choices.

findings.title: Elemental resistances remain capped with room after the -30 penalty

findings.title: Mana can still run short during sustained mine throwing
findings.detail: Pyroclast Mine costs 10 Mana per mine and PoB calculates 34.47 Mana/sec. The character has 107 unreserved Mana and 13.3 Mana/sec regeneration.
findings.action: Keep the Warding Mana Flask and avoid spending all free Mana before an escape. If you notice stalls, compare Inspiration against Controlled Destruction in PoB before changing the link.

findings.title: Physical-hit defense remains the main survivability gap
findings.detail: Physical maximum hit is 3805 and Armour is 1174 (PoB reports 9% physical damage reduction); attack block is 26%. This is improved, but a large physical hit remains the weakest listed hit threshold.
findings.action: Prioritize more flat Life and armour/physical mitigation on upgrades and keep a defensive flask available. Do not treat 9339 Total EHP as a substitute for the lower physical maximum-hit value.
